question: Which of the following compounds contains only one carbon-carbon single bond?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ethane**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ethane is a saturated hydrocarbon among given options.
 
• Saturated hydrocarbons are molecules with **only single bonds**.

 [IMAGE: https://qph.fs.quoracdn.net/main-qimg-466c8d4526094ca7f563a9b947e60e11.webp] - Ethane

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fe207617bc052211c6a9e4eeacc9dca1a8e97270c9f5466b11a26a4cb6e31b6.png] - Ethene

 [IMAGE: https://alchetron.com/cdn/propene-52dfc75f-586d-4b48-b284-94c010c10a7-resize-750.jpeg] - Propene

 [IMAGE: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/1e/Structural_formula_of_acetylene.svg/1200px-Structural_formula_of_acetylene.svg.png] - Acetylene

 
• Only ethane has all single bond while others have a double and triple bond.

 
• Methane, Ethane, Propane, Butane, etc are examples of saturated hydrocarbons.
 
• Alkanes are saturated hydrocarbons and classified as a type of aliphatic hydrocarbon.
 
• Bonding between every single bond in a saturated hydrocarbon is covalent in nature**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Unsaturated hydrocarbons contain **multiple bonding and contain less than the maximum number of hydrogens per carbon**.
 
• Unsaturated hydrocarbons have double or triple covalent between adjacent carbon atoms.
 
• Aromatic hydrocarbons are a special case of unsaturated hydrocarbons.
